Name: Slow Time
Author: DantedeWalje
Description:
[b][color=#d4d4d8]Description[/color][/b]
[left][color=#d4d4d8]Take complete control over time, stamina, and daily flow in Stardew Valley—built from the ground up with multiplayer support in mind.[/color][/left]
[left][color=#d4d4d8]This mod lets host players adjust game speed, automatically freeze time at night, recover stamina by resting on furniture, and receive dynamic luck-based morning buffs to kickstart each day.[/color][/left]
[color=#D4D4D8]
[b]Requirements[/b][/color]
[list]
Stardew ValleySMAPI (v4.0.0 or newer)[/list][list]
(Optional) Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) — Required to change settings in-game via the options menu.[/list][color=#D4D4D8][b]Main Features[/b][/color]
[list]
Multiplayer-Friendly Time Scaling: Adjust time progression from 0.25x (4x slower) to 2.0x speed. [/list][list]
Host-only execution ensures zero desyncs for joiners.[/list][list]
Automatic Night Freeze: Set a specific time (e.g., 23:00 or 00:00) where time automatically halts, allowing you to finish late-night farm chores without passing out.[/list][list]
Rest & Stamina Recovery: Sitting on any chair or bench gradually restores your energy (1 to 20 stamina per second) and can optionally speed time back up to normal while resting.[/list][list]
Rest & Health Recovery: Sitting on any chair or bench gradually restores your health (1 to 10 health per second).[/list][list]
Luck-Based Morning Vigor: Wake up with a custom "Vigorous" buff (+2 Speed, +30 Max Stamina). Its duration dynamically scales from 4 to 15 minutes based on your Daily Luck.[/list][color=#D4D4D8][b]Installation Instructions[/b][/color]

[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download and install [b]SMAPI[/b].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download this mod's [/color]Slow Time.zip file and extract its contents.[/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Move the extracted folder into your "Stardew Valley/Mods" directory.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][i](Recommended)[/i] Install [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] to tweak settings in-game.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch the game using SMAPI and enjoy![/color]
[/*]
[/list]
